main_text.l: care coepi. Etsi uerò tum eius argumen-

page.notes: The woodcut initial "I" (historiated, showing figures) is joined to "ERTIVS"; the first word reads "ERTIVS" with the initial letter pictured, probably "VERTIVS" or "Vertius" with the initial omitted.
